name: Planar Emperor
desc: The wizard becoming sovereign over all planes of existence with every entity acknowledging their absolute authority

name: Void Prison
desc: An enemy wizard being imprisoned in the void between planes trapped for eternity in absolute nothingness

name: Master Binder
desc: A hero becoming the ultimate binder able to summon and bind any creature from any plane instantly and permanently

name: Spirit Sight
desc: A medium's eyes glowing silver as they perceive the spirit world seeing ghosts and ethereal entities

name: Ancestral Guidance
desc: Faint ghostly ancestors appearing around a hero whispering advice and improving their skill in all areas

name: Spirit Bolt
desc: A bolt of ghostly blue-white energy streaking from a medium's hands chilling the soul of any target struck

name: Ghost Scout
desc: A ghostly spirit being sent to scout ahead floating through walls and obstacles completely undetectable

name: Haunting
desc: Ghosts being sent to haunt a location making enemies uneasy and reducing morale with supernatural dread

desc: A medium communing with the spirits of the dead gaining knowledge and intelligence from beyond the grave

name: Spirit Shield
desc: Ghostly hands forming a protective barrier around a unit deflecting attacks with spectral force

name: Minor Possession
desc: A weak spirit being directed to possess an enemy unit briefly disrupting their actions and causing confusion

name: Spirit Ward
desc: Protective spirit wards being placed around a city calming restless ghosts and blocking hostile spirits

name: Death Sense

name: Ethereal Step

desc: The spirits of a hero's ancestors being called forth to fight alongside them as ghostly protectors

name: Spirit Touch

name: Possession

name: Spirit Army
desc: An army of ancestral spirits rising from the earth armed with ghostly weapons from battles long past

name: Astral Projection

name: Spirit Guardian
desc: A powerful ancestral spirit manifesting as a warrior guardian with ethereal weapons and spectral armor

name: Mass Haunting
desc: Hundreds of ghosts descending on an enemy city terrifying the populace and reducing production and morale

name: Ethereal Army
desc: An army becoming ethereal able to pass through walls and terrain while remaining able to fight normally

name: Ancestral Forge

name: Poltergeist Storm

name: Spirit Walk
desc: A unit walking through the spirit realm traveling between locations at incredible speed ignoring physical terrain

name: Ancestral Knowledge

name: Ghost Ship
desc: A spectral ship materializing from fog crewed by ghostly sailors able to cross any water at supernatural speed

name: Spirit Binding
desc: A powerful spirit being bound to a hero providing constant guidance protection and spiritual power

name: Banshee
desc: A wailing female spirit appearing whose terrible shriek can kill the living with pure supernatural dread

name: Revenant Lord
desc: A mighty revenant a spirit of vengeance so powerful it has manifested a physical form of cold iron and spectral fire

name: Mass Possession
desc: Spirits possessing every enemy unit on the battlefield turning the entire army against its own commander

name: Spirit Realm Gate
desc: A permanent gate to the spirit realm opening in a city allowing constant communion with ancestral spirits

name: Ancestral Army
desc: The spirits of an ancient civilization's greatest warriors manifesting in full force with legendary equipment

name: Haunt World
desc: Spirits haunting every enemy city and army across the world draining morale and causing fear everywhere

name: Spirit King

name: Ethereal Fortress
desc: A city becoming partially ethereal existing between planes and nearly impossible for physical armies to attack

name: Ancestral Champion
desc: A hero channeling the spirit of their greatest ancestor gaining all their skills power and legendary abilities

name: Spirit Plague
desc: Malicious spirits infesting an enemy region causing sickness madness and terror as they torment the populace

name: Greater Astral Form
desc: A hero's astral body becoming immensely powerful able to project devastating force while immune to physical harm

name: Spirit Council
desc: A council of the most powerful ancestral spirits being convened to advise the wizard on all matters of strategy

name: Spectral Dragon
desc: The ghost of an ancient dragon manifesting with ghostly fire breath and the ability to phase through matter

name: Soul Storm
desc: A howling storm of lost souls sweeping across the battlefield tearing at the spirits of living enemies

name: Ancestral Blessing
desc: All ancestors across the wizard's domain being honored as their blessings strengthen every city and army

name: Death Gate
desc: A gate to the realm of the dead being opened allowing the medium to conscript spirits of the recently deceased

name: Spirit God
desc: The supreme spirit deity manifesting as a vast ethereal being of pure spiritual energy commanding all ghosts and souls

name: Absolute Possession

name: World Soul Harvest

name: Spectral Colossus

name: Reincarnation Mastery

name: Spirit Tempest
desc: A cataclysmic storm of spiritual energy ravaging the battlefield as millions of spirits tear through enemy ranks

name: Ancestral Transcendence
desc: A hero merging with all their ancestors becoming a composite being of immense wisdom power and experience

name: Death Dominion
desc: Absolute control over the boundary between life and death allowing the wizard to decide who lives and who dies

name: Void of Spirits
desc: A void opening where all spirits are drawn consuming the spiritual essence of an entire enemy territory leaving it hollow
